metadata.question: Does Somalia show lower soil moisture in April 2019 compared to the average April conditions?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare soil moisture in Somalia for April 2019 against average April conditions. 1. Data strategy: Use SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) data which provides soil moisture measurements. SMAP L4 product has global soil moisture data. 2. Time periods: - Target: April 2019 (2019-04-01 to 2019-04-30) - Baseline: Multiple years of April data for average (e.g., 2015-2020 excluding 2019) 3. Location: Somalia - I'll define a polygon covering Somalia 4. Processing: - Calculate mean soil moisture for April 2019 - Calculate mean soil moisture for baseline April periods - Compare if 2019 is lower than baseline 5. Validation: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate the calculated values I'll use SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture product. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const somalia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [40.981, 11.987], [51.412, 11.987], [51.412, -1.659], [40.981, -1.659], [40.981, 11.987] ]); const april2019 = ['2019-04-01', '2019-04-30']; const baselineStart = '2015-04-01'; const baselineEnd = '2020-04-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - SMAP Soil Moisture const smapCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL4SMGP/007') .select('sm_surface'); // April 2019 data const april2019Col = smapCollection.filterDate(april2019[0], april2019[1]); // Baseline data (all Aprils 2015-2020 excluding 2019) const baselineCol = smapCollection .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.neq('year', 2019)); // Check collection sizes const april2019Size = april2019Col.size().getInfo(); const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${april2019Size}`); console.log(`Baseline April Images: ${baselineSize}`); if (april2019Size === 0 || baselineSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean soil moisture const april2019Mean = april2019Col.mean(); const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); // Check pixel counts const april2019Count = april2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: somalia, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); const baselineCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: somalia, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Valid Pixels: ${april2019Count}`); console.log(`Baseline Valid Pixels: ${baselineCount}`); if (april2019Count === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean soil moisture values const april2019Val = april2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); const baselineVal = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 9000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sm_surface').getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Soil Moisture: ${april2019Val?.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Baseline Soil Moisture: ${baselineVal?.toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (april2019Val === null || baselineVal === null || isNaN(april2019Val) || isNaN(baselineVal) || april2019Val < 0 || baselineVal < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (april2019Val < baselineVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
